archetypes.name: cutoff-timing
archetypes.rationale: Adaptive deadlines are sensitive to race and timing semantics.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the waterfall reaper changes for deadline math, process cleanup, and collector-validated anchor behavior. Focus on whether straggler drops can accidentally trigger fallback or corrupt output ordering. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: coverage-gates
archetypes.rationale: Straggler drops now flow through review-core gates and dropped-slot sidecars.
archetypes.prompt_body: Check that straggler-dropped rows are excluded only from the intended failure and static coverage gates. Verify other drop reasons still fail as before and that dynamic slots are not accidentally excused as static archetypes. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
